## Automated Tests Required

### 3-1 Multiplayer Isolation Boundary — Logic
**Test file path**: `Assets/tests/unit/multiplayer/MultiplayerIsolationTests.cs` (+ `MultiplayerUnitTests.asmdef`)
**What to test**:
- `INetworkSimulationDriver` published with the 5 exact ADR-0017 signatures + `RemoteInputsReceivedHandler` delegate
- `Overdrive.Multiplayer` assembly engine-free (references only Overdrive.Simulation + Unity.Mathematics; noEngineReferences)
- `SimulationRollbackState` readonly struct + Array16 wrappers (architecture.md:621-626 shape) + `NetworkInput` placeholder + factory validation
- Isolation scan: manifest of gameplay assemblies scanned, fail-closed on forbidden namespaces (match by namespace boundary), editor-only excluded
- Package denylist: manifest.json + packages-lock.json scanned deterministically
- Reflection proves no concrete type implements `INetworkSimulationDriver`
- Alpha/Beta deferral verified by absence

**Edge cases to cover**:
- `Create(null, ...)` throws ArgumentException (not NullReference)
- Namespace boundary match (no false positives on substring "Transport" vs `UnityEngine.Networking`)
- Editor-only assemblies/packages excluded from fail-closed scan
- Empty array / null input to factories

**Estimated test count**: ~7 unit tests

### 3-2 Settings Persistence & Migration — Logic
**Test file path**: `Assets/tests/unit/settings/SettingsPersistenceTests.cs`
**What to test**:
- Settings blob JSON round-trip: save → load → identical values (all 7 sub-structs)
- Backup-first write (corruption → backup recovery)
- Migration v1→v3 (field add/remove/rename with defaults)
- Load cascade (primary → backup → defaults)

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Corrupt JSON file → backup recovery path
- Missing version field → default migration
- Empty/partial blob → per-field defaults
- Unknown fields in blob → ignored (forward compat)

**Estimated test count**: ~7 unit tests

### 3-3 SettingsEditSession & Lifecycle — Logic
**Test file path**: `Assets/tests/unit/settings/SettingsEditSessionTests.cs`
**What to test**:
- Snapshot/working/Apply/Cancel semantics
- One-session rule (second Open rejected while open)
- Lifecycle gating (Countdown/racing blocks settings open — AC-ST1)
- Difficulty-disabled during race (AC-D6)
- Apply persists + broadcasts; Cancel discards working changes

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Open → Open (rejected)
- Apply with no changes (no-op)
- Cancel after Apply (already persisted)
- Open during countdown (blocked)

**Estimated test count**: ~5 unit tests

### 3-4 DifficultyProfile & Race Snapshot — Integration
**Test file path**: `Assets/tests/unit/settings/DifficultyProfileTests.cs` + `Assets/tests/integration/settings/DifficultyProfileIntegrationTests.cs`
**What to test**:
- 5 ScriptableObject profiles (AI precision, error mult, pace noise, grip, wall loss)
- Simulation contract expansion (DifficultyProfile carries full fields — additive to Kernel Level-only stub)
- Immutability (profile cannot mutate after load)
- Composition root: `Settings.GetProfile(id)` → snapshot at race init → `ReplayInitialState` carries it
- Race-snapshot contract verified (Kernel ReplayInitialState.DifficultyProfile populated)

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Unknown profile id → default profile fallback
- Profile mutation attempt → rejected (immutable)
- Null difficulty in ReplayInitialState capture → defaults

**Estimated test count**: ~4 unit + ~2 integration

### 3-5 Control Bindings & Rebinding State Machine — Logic
**Test file path**: `Assets/tests/unit/settings/ControlBindingTests.cs` (+ integration)
**What to test**:
- `IRebindCapture` port with `BindingTarget { ActionId, BindingId, Scheme/composite-part, SlotIndex }` + `CaptureResult` (typed `RejectionReason`: Reserved/UnknownAction/UnknownBinding/MalformedPath/DuplicateCandidate/DeviceLost)
- State machine: Open → Listening → BindingConflict (10 slots KBM + 4 Gamepad + composite parts), DI via `IRebindCapture` ctor injection + fake capture events
- Working override-set via `GetWorkingOverrides()` (FULL set; exactly one changed slot vs pre-rebind baseline — AC-C6)
- `BindingMigrationResult` mapping (unknown BindingId → affected slot default + typed issues, valid overrides preserved — AC-C12/E4)
- Reserved rejection (Confirm/Cancel/Pause — AC-C8/C9, typed via CaptureStartResult.Reason)
- `ISchemeProbe.ActiveScheme` never mutated by Settings during capture (AC-E11, fake in unit / InputContextController-backed in integration; arbitration on reconnect stays InputContextController's domain)
- Duplicate persisted bindings → first preserved, second slot defaulted (AC-E4)

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Capture with no action (rejected)
- Conflict resolution (reserve slot, rebind displaced)
- Zero slots lost during rebind (full coverage)
- Bindings reload after persistence (round-trip)

**Estimated test count**: ~4 unit + ~2 integration

### 3-8 Content Groups & Address Mirror — Config/Data + Editor
**Test file path**: `Assets/tests/editor/content/ContentTopologyTests.cs`
**What to test**:
- Two-layer validation: structural (topology.json real manifest → 21 groups, 3 categories, exact team/track IDs, rootAddresses) + semantic (validator logic against a fixture `ContentTopologyData` + temporary `AddressableAssetSettings` — never the global `AddressableAssetSettingsDefaultObject`)
- 3 categories / 21 groups (1 Shared + 16 Cars + 4 Tracks: monaco, monza, silverstone, spa) — full project topology
- Address mirror: `Cars/{teamId}/CarDefinition`, `Tracks/{trackId}/TrackData`; root address read from `AddressableAssetEntry.address`; group names never used as runtime keys (Story 003 enforcement)
- Negative fixtures: shared CarDefinition address (fail), mismatched group/address (fail), missing TrackData (fail), cross-car dependency via `[SerializeField]` reference + `AssetDatabase.GetDependencies` (fail)

**Edge cases to cover**:
- 20/22 groups (fail — must be exactly 21)
- Cross-team asset in car group (fail)
- Empty/missing root address → AddressMirrorViolation
- Shared group entry of car/track type or path (fail)

**Estimated test count**: ~7 editor tests

### 3-9 CP_ State Machine & Kernel Handshake — Logic
**Test file path**: `Assets/tests/unit/content/ContentStateMachineTests.cs`
**What to test**:
- 7-state lifecycle (Idle → LoadingTrack → LoadingCars → Ready → Racing → Unloading → Idle)
- Handshake direction: Content emits `RaceLoadReady(mode, grid)`, Simulation accepts; never reverse
- `ContentLoadError` path → Unloading → Idle (after cleanup)
- `ContentUnloadComplete` only after all handles released
- RaceReconfigure (same selection, GDD:146): CP_Racing + ContentLoadRequested → RaceReconfigure → Ready → re-emit RaceLoadReady → Racing (terminal), `RaceReconfigureStart` emitted once, ZERO Addressables I/O (spy on IContentLoadSeam), handoff validity renewed; covers the Kernel racing retry (RequestRetry — lightweight restart, ADR-0003:53)
- Double-request idempotency (second ignored while busy)

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Selection-source query EXACTLY ONCE per accepted request (Idle and CP_Racing paths; zero for ignored busy requests)
- AC-LO5 aggregation: fewer than 16 completed car slots (ReportCarLoaded OR ReportCarDegraded per slot, GDD:144) → stays Loading Cars; full set (1 track + 16 slots) → Ready
- AC-LO6 exact payload: RaceLoadReady(mode, grid) carries the STORED payload, never invented
- AC-LO7: ContentUnloadRequested from CP_Ready/CP_Racing/CP_RaceReconfigure → Unloading without Kernel Idle
- Error in LoadingTrack vs LoadingCars (same cleanup path)
- Next race (changed selection, GDD:147): CP_Racing + ContentLoadRequested → Loading Track (NOT reconfigure), handoff validity cleared, no ContentUnloadComplete
- ContentUnloadRequest without prior load (no-op)
- Shared-already-loaded precondition (AC-SM1)

**Estimated test count**: ~12 unit tests

### 3-10 Race Load Orchestration — Integration
**Test file path**: `Assets/tests/unit/content/RaceLoadTests.cs` + `Assets/tests/integration/content/RaceLoadIntegrationTests.cs`
**What to test**:
- 17 async handles start in parallel before any completes
- Progress monotonic from `GetDownloadStatus()` bytes (25/50/75% sampled)
- `IRaceContentRuntime` handoff: TrackInstance + CarReferences + Grid populated BEFORE RaceLoadReady
- Memory policy: <0.85 no warning; 0.85-0.95 warning + quality reduction; >0.95 abort + cleanup + ContentLoadError
- Car failure → `CarLoadDegraded(reason, teamId)` non-fatal, placeholder, race continues with 15
- Selection registration + stale rejection + reconfigure identity rule

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Cached-load zero total bytes (progress handling)
- Exactly 0.95 memory boundary
- 1/16 car fails → progress still reaches 100%
- Track instantiation before car refs (ordering)
- Stale selection rejected

**Estimated test count**: ~12 unit + ~3 integration

### 3-11 Race Unload — Logic
**Test file path**: `Assets/tests/unit/content/RaceUnloadTests.cs`
**What to test**:
- ReleaseInstance (all instances) then Release (all handles) before ContentUnloadComplete
- UnloadRace called first at start of every LoadRace
- Same-track reload = full unload + reload (not retained)
- Partial-handle cleanup on abortive error (5/17 loaded → 5 released)
- `IRaceContentRuntime.IsValid` → false after unload

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Unload with no load (no-op)
- Double unload (idempotent)
- Unload during loading (abort path)

**Estimated test count**: ~7 unit tests

### 3-12 Startup, Catalog & Fatal Errors — Logic
**Test file path**: `Assets/tests/unit/content/StartupErrorTests.cs` (+ platform integration)
**What to test**:
- Catalog init retry once; retry fails → app closes; retry succeeds → proceeds
- Shared group failure at startup → fatal (error shown, app closes)
- Track failure → ContentLoadError(ErrorType.Track), return to Idle, no crash
- Error classification: correct ContentErrorType (Track/Shared/Catalog) AFTER cleanup
- WebGL pause/resume on focus loss (injectable focus seam)

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Catalog retry then success
- Cleanup-before-error ordering violated → fail
- Repeated background/foreground (WebGL)
- Startup success → CP_Idle with Shared retained

**Estimated test count**: ~6 unit + ~2 platform integration

### 3-13 Loading Screen — UI
**Test file path**: `Assets/tests/unit/content/LoadingScreenControllerTests.cs` + `production/qa/evidence/loading-screen-evidence.md`
**What to test** (controller via fake/headless `ILoadingScreenPresenter`):
- Progress bar 0% at start, monotonic 0→100%
- Min 0.5s display (injectable clock) even on instant load
- Completion signals immediately (no additional progress hold; 300ms fade is UI Menu's AC)
- "Preparing..." + spinner on first-launch catalog init
- Input blocked during loading (InputBlocked flag via presenter)
- Cancel/Back mid-load ignored (EC5)
- VFX failure → skip, progress bar still functions

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Out-of-order progress (clamped monotonic)
- Instant load (<0.5s) still shows 0.5s
- VFX failure + Reduced Motion (no VFX, no fade, static bar)

**Estimated test count**: ~11 unit tests (controller)

**Manual verification** (presentation — UI Menu epic collaborates):
- Progress bar visual 0→100% monotonic
- "Loading..." above bar, percentage below
- 300ms fade-from-black exit (Reduced Motion: instant)
- Spinner on first launch

### 3-14 Quality Profiles (WebGL) — Integration
**Test file path**: `Assets/tests/integration/content/QualityProfileIntegrationTests.cs`
**What to test**:
- Settings preset → `IQualityProfileSource.Current` → Content applies texture mipmap policy (`QualitySettings.globalTextureMipmapLimit`)
- Low (WebGL) → lower resolution limit; High (PC) → limit = 0 (full res)
- Medium default on WebGL, Low explicit fallback available
- Cross-story: Settings preset → URP/VFX applier + Content mipmap consistent; PerformanceReduced → Low density override without rewriting persisted prefs

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Each quality level's limit mapping correct
- Override clears → returns to working preset
- Content mipmap policy applied per load

**Estimated test count**: ~4 integration tests

## Manual QA Checklist

### 3-13 Loading Screen — UI
**Verification method**: Manual step-through + screenshot
**Who must sign off**: qa-lead (visual layout) + ui-programmer (presentation)
**Evidence to capture**: `production/qa/evidence/loading-screen-evidence.md` with screenshots

Checklist:
- [ ] Progress bar shown at 0% when loading begins
- [ ] Progress increases monotonically 0→100% (no jumps backward)
- [ ] "Loading..." text above bar, percentage below
- [ ] "Preparing..." + spinner on first-launch catalog init
- [ ] All input blocked during loading (no race start mid-load)

- [ ] Exit uses 300ms fade-from-black (instant under Reduced Motion)

- [ ] Reduced Motion: no VFX, no fade, static progress bar

## Smoke Test Scope

Critical paths to verify before any QA hand-off for this sprint:

1. Editor compiles without errors (new assemblies Overdrive.Settings + Overdrive.Content + Overdrive.Multiplayer)
2. Full PlayMode suite passes without regression (Sprint 2: 418/418 preserved + new tests)
3. Game launches to menu → catalog init → Shared group loads → CP_Idle without crash (3-12)
4. LoadRace starts 17 bundles in parallel → progress → RaceLoadReady → race runs (3-10)
5. UnloadRace → ContentUnloadComplete → Idle, no leaks (3-11)
6. Settings round-trip: change → save → reload → identical values (3-2)
7. Display confirm 15s → confirm/cancel/timeout → rollback correct (3-6)
8. Pause/focus-loss during race still works (Kernel regression check)
9. Performance within budget — no new frame spikes (p95 ≤ 6ms / max ≤ 8ms per ADR-0010)

*Smoke tests are verified by the developer via `/smoke-check`. Reference this list when running that skill.*

## Definition of Done — This Sprint

A story is DONE when ALL of the following are true:

- [ ] All acceptance criteria verified — via automated test result OR documented manual evidence (screenshot or interaction walkthrough with sign-off)
- [ ] Test file exists at the specified path for all Logic, Integration, and Config/Data stories (9 Logic + 3 Integration + 1 Config/Data = 13 test files; 3-13 UI has controller test + evidence doc)
- [ ] Manual evidence document exists for the UI story (3-13 Loading Screen)
- [ ] Smoke check passes (run `/smoke-check sprint` before QA hand-off)
- [ ] No regressions introduced (Sprint 2: 418/418 PlayMode green preserved)
- [ ] Code reviewed (via `/code-review` per story)
- [ ] Story file updated to `Status: Complete` (via `/story-done`)
